a.lede: Some USB connectors, including USB-A, feature two small holes that have an important purpose. Other USB connectors lack these holes for a reason, too.
a.title: Why do some USB connectors have those 2 square holes?

b.lede: Not every USB port color means what you think. Learn why yellow ports are so uncommon and what to check before you plug in anything important.
b.title: Why some USB ports are yellow (and less common than others)
